verdict.rationale: Supabase Auth documents its own Auth Hooks: Postgres functions that run automatically at key auth lifecycle points, such as the Custom Access Token Hook that changes token claims. This is event-driven automation, but it is limited to hook points the product defines and is evidenced only by brief doc lines. Database triggers on auth data are a Postgres feature, so they are only adjacent. Missing for 10: a list of the supported lifecycle events, a general rule-definition or condition model, actions beyond Postgres functions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Customize Auth behavior with Postgres functions at key lifecycle points.
You can use a [Custom Access Token Hook](/docs/guides/auth/auth-hooks/custom-access-token-hook) to add, remove or change claims present in the token.
